completed_scope: Origin-flat actual cutoff sources form a closed proper subimage of I; the genuine h0 source gives the uniform negative-time P3 lower bound5*zeta(3)/(8*pi)*exp(5*abs(a)/2), independently of adaptive cutoff scales.

A legal finite-rank source projection restores the firstK negative-even Mellin values and preserves all actual nontrivial zero jets, with a finite input seminorm. K may depend on output n; large source coefficients are not an obstruction without a bound on the joint residual.
A source selected once and then only covariantly transported has an unavoidable exp((n+1/2)*abs(a)) residual for any nonzero fixed remainder; the original contract permits time-dependent reselection.

Classical unconditional Mobius cancellation pays raw-source L1 zero mass and cutoff mass coefficients uniformly in a finite input seminorm. Critical all-probe and zero-free-numerator Gaussian estimates are RH-equivalent audits, not independent arithmetic advances.
A nonnegative compact probe can cancel the full multiplicity of a selected conjugate zero pair; the actual h0 Gaussian source is distinct from a zero-free-Mellin target Gaussian.

Double-ended positive exponential Hilbert quotients faithfully retain every actual zero jet when the weight strip covers(0,1). Exact cross-Gram and actual central near-frequency pairs exclude unitary metrics equivalent to these fixed natural quotient norms.

The obstruction extends to fixed finite positive multi-exponential weights whose strip contains the center. A specific three-weight critical limit makes every fixed original quotient class have norm tending to zero even though each finite member is faithful.
limits: No proof of RH, narrower zero-free boundary, new zero proportion, new paper, Lean run or website submission.
Fixed finite Taylor repair does not by itself bound the full target residual; the cutoff and compensation terms must be estimated together, retaining signed cancellation.
The mass compensator E_beta by itself generally lies outside F because beta has nonzero ordinary mass; its negative-end exp(-t) term must be cancelled jointly with the cutoff tail before using P_n.
Classical Conrey zero counts and unconditional Mertens bounds are cited inputs, not reproved by finite diagnostics. Floating checks are not interval or Lean certificates.

No impossibility theorem for all Hilbert models: independent non-equivalent arithmetic realizations remain open. A faithful positive unitary model would additionally exclude nontrivial Jordan multiplicities.
Full Weil sign, geometric principal/correspondences, global HH completion, sections and Riemann-Roch remain open.
